execution_incidents.scope: The runner completed the first TEST subset's BM25, BGE, and MedCPT fixed arms, then stopped before RRF reranking because its guard required the base-ranking key set to equal exactly {bm25, medcpt_dense}; the joint frozen run also correctly contained bge_dense.
execution_incidents.fix: Validate that the two required RRF inputs are present while allowing additional arms in the same joint run. Retrieval method, model, parameters, and DEV-selected comparator were unchanged.
execution_incidents.recovery: Reran the complete locked TEST. Same-identity completed fixed-arm outputs were validated and reused; all four arms and all three subsets passed completion checks.

execution_incidents.scope: After the full retrieval run completed, the analyzer found query IDs reused across benchmark subsets and rejected the rows because it keyed them by query_id alone. No TEST report was emitted by this attempt.
execution_incidents.fix: Pair on a collision-safe composite of subset and query_id, while still rejecting duplicate IDs within a subset. Added regression tests; the metric formula and bootstrap procedure were unchanged.
execution_incidents.recovery: Reanalyzed the completed TEST outputs with the fixed analyzer and wrote runs/e1_2/r2med_test_report.json.

headline_gate.metric: equal-weight macro nDCG@10 difference for rrf_medcpt_rerank versus the DEV-selected bge_dense baseline

data_and_license_disclosure.summary: Hugging Face package cards label the packaged data CC-BY-4.0, while R2MED paper Table 8 lists differing source terms, including CC-BY-SA, MIT, CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0, and unspecified entries. The paper's source-level terms are disclosed alongside the package-level label; the package label is not treated as superseding them.
